item.title: UPDATE: Westbound traffic reopened on US 30 after investigation
item.description: WARSAW, Ind. -- The Warsaw Police Department confirmed Monday evening that officers are on the scene of a critical accident involving a pedestrian on US 30 in the area of Meijer Drive.

item.title: Local bakeries prepare for Fat Tuesday rush
item.description: MISHAWAKA, Ind.-- Tomorrow is Fat Tuesday, and bakeries across Michiana are preparing their paczki! It's part of a pre-Lenten tradition said to have started back in the Middle Ages.

item.title: 20-year-old facing additional charge in shooting at Riverbend Apartments
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- Daqwan Jackson Burnett is now facing an additional change in the March 2025 shooting at Arbors at Riverbend Apartments.

item.title: UPDATE: Suspect in custody after shooting two officers in Beech Grove
item.description: BEECH GROVE, Ind. -- The Indiana State Police have issued a Blue Alert following an investigation of Kenneth Johnson for the involvement of injuries made to a law enforcement officer.

item.title: Countdown to Kindergarten program launches across Elkhart County
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- The Community Foundation of Elkhart County, through the Building Strong Brains Coalition, is launching Countdown to Kindergarten for families across Elkhart County.

item.title: Officer deceased after being shot by suspect in Beech Grove
item.description: BEECH GROVE, Ind. -- One of the two officers shot Monday evening in in Beech Grove has been pronounced dead by the Beech Grove Police Department.

item.title: MDOT says final year of rebuilding I-94 project in Berrien County has begun
item.description: BERRIEN COUNTY, Mich. -- The Michigan Department of Transportation announced work resumes Monday to rebuild 8.5 miles of I-94 and four bridges, plus repair nine other bridges between Puetz Road and Britain Avenue.

item.title: South Bend restaurants bring taste of New Orleans to Fat Tuesday celebrations
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- In Michiana, Fat Tuesday often means paczki boxes stacked high on bakery counters. But at a couple of South Bend establishments, Mardi Gras is about more than powdered sugar. It’s about music, family recipes and bringing a taste of New Orleans to northern Indiana.

item.title: The Cost of Power: ABC57 asks NIPSCO CEO top community questions
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. — ABC57 sat down for a 15-minute zoom meeting Mon. afternoon with the Northern Indiana Public Service Company (NIPSCO) president and CEO, Vince Parisi.

item.title: Callahan's Restaurant in Elkhart announces closure after 42 years
item.description: Callahan's Restaurant announced Monday that their last day of business will be Sunday, Mar. 1.
